summary: A mixed legal and retail day, with key developments in arbitration governance, a major retail distribution dispute, and Reliance's bond issuance plans. The arbitration register proposal and Vadilal distribution blocking are the primary drivers.

bullets.text: CJI Surya Kant proposes mandatory register tracking arbitrators' conflicts of interest and caseload to improve transparency.
Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of 10-year distribution pact with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries, disrupting domestic supply chain.
Reliance Industries to sell 5-year rupee bonds raising $1.3 billion, first domestic bond issuance since 2023.
HDFC Bank submits two CEO candidates to RBI for managing director and chief executive officer position.
Nexus Select Trust acquires Guwahati mall and hotel for ₹1,600 crore with Khaitan & Co and Antares Legal advising.
